scenes.title: The bay is singing
scenes.objective: Help Frank find the strange hum on his radio.

tasks.title: Frank’s radio
tasks.prompt: Two stations crackle on Frank’s radio: a time signal on one side, a chime on the other. Something hums in between. Drag the dial until both stations fade, switch on Narrow bandwidth, then record.
options: Tune between the stations and narrow the band
tasks.note: Found the ship’s hum beneath the radio static.
tasks.hint: Look at the evidence in the description, then try another approach.
hints: Drag the dial toward the middle, away from both stations.
The hum sits at 815 kHz. Narrow bandwidth shuts out the stations on either side.
Set the dial to 815 kHz, switch on Narrow bandwidth, then press Record the signal.

tasks.title: Helen’s phone
tasks.prompt: Steve stayed ashore for his shift. Helen wants him to hear this too. How can she reach him tonight?
options: Write it in the boat’s logbook
tasks.hint: Look at the evidence in the description, then try another approach.
hints: Steve is at work, far from the boat.
Which of these will Steve find without coming out on the water?

shots.direction: Drift beside the rowboat as turquoise light grows beneath black water.

chapter.title: The Bay Is Singing
chapter.goal: Frank and Helen Mercer row out to listen to the bay.

scenes.coach: Click the glowing radio to begin. Press I for a list of things to look at.

p_bay.in.01.speaker: frank
p_bay.in.01.text: Same interval as last Thursday, Helen. Louder out here. Whatever it is, it keeps better time than I do.

p_bay.in.02.speaker: helen
p_bay.in.02.text: Steve would hear more in this than both of us put together. I’ll leave him a message.

p_bay.out.01.speaker: helen
p_bay.out.01.text: Come out with us, kiddo. The bay is singing tonight.

p_bay.tune.01.speaker: frank
p_bay.tune.01.text: There you are. Hear that, Helen? More than one voice, all holding the same note.

p_bay.message.01.speaker: helen
p_bay.message.01.text: He should hear this for himself. We’ll bring the tape home, and he’ll tell us we recorded it wrong.
